name: Neighborhood Weighted Gaussian Mixture Model
aliases: Gaussian Mixture Model with Neighborhood Weighting
definition: A classification method for vectorial volumes that integrates neighborhood information into the Gaussian mixture model to solve misclassification on boundaries and inhomogeneous regions with noise.
summary: The Neighborhood Weighted Gaussian Mixture Model classifies vectorial volumes by weighting class probabilities with neighboring voxel data to enforce spatial continuity and reduce noise sensitivity.
